text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Mejiro Dober! You were
awesome—just incredible! That was<n>an amazing
run!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I've fulfilled my promise and<n>watched over your
classic year,<n>Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The next time we meet, you and I will<n>be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (It's over. The Triple Tiara is over.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I don't regret anything. After all, I ran<n>without
holding anything back.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can't cry... I have to stay strong for<n>their sake!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober leaves the crowd<n>behind, and I head
out to meet her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I may not have won the Triple Tiara,<n>but I'm
satisfied with how things<n>turned out.
